# Bizco REST API — Module Documentation

**Status:** Reflects the REST controllers actually implemented in `bizco-server` as of 2026-08-20 (branch `documentation`, latest purchasing commit `5456504`).
**Source of truth:** This document is generated by reading the live `@RestController` classes and their DTOs (`bizco-common/src/main/java/com/bizco/common/dto/**`), not by re-stating the aspirational design in [`ApiContracts.md`](../ApiContracts.md). Where behavior differs from `ApiContracts.md`, the implementation described here wins.

---

## 1. Implemented Modules

| Module | Doc | Controllers |
|---|---|---|
| Identity (auth, users, roles, permissions, login history, technicians) | [Identity.md](Identity.md) | `AuthController`, `UserController`, `RoleController`, `LoginHistoryController`, `StaffTechnicianController` |
| Audit | [Audit.md](Audit.md) | `AuditLogController` |
| Catalog (categories, UOM, products, services, barcodes, brands, attributes, variants) | [Catalog.md](Catalog.md) | `CatalogController`, `VariantController` |
| Customer | [Customer.md](Customer.md) | `CustomerController` |
| Inventory (stock levels/movements, low-stock, stock adjustments) | [Inventory.md](Inventory.md) | `StockController`, `StockAdjustmentController` |
| Purchasing (suppliers, supplier product catalog, purchase orders, goods receipts, supplier returns/payments) | [Purchasing.md](Purchasing.md) | `SupplierController`, `SupplierProductController`, `PurchaseOrderController`, `GoodsReceiptController`, `SupplierPaymentController`, `SupplierReturnController` |
| Sales (invoices — draft through post/void, payments, held sales, credit notes, receipts) | [Sales.md](Sales.md) | `InvoiceController`, `SalesApprovalController`, `HeldSaleController`, `CreditNoteController`, `CustomerPaymentController` |
| Scheduling (appointments, job cards, estimates, parts, service invoicing) | [Scheduling.md](Scheduling.md) | `AppointmentController`, `JobCardController` (technician list is under Identity — see [Scheduling.md](Scheduling.md) §11) |
| System (health, business profile, tax config, system config) | [System.md](System.md) | `HealthController`, `BusinessProfileController`, `SystemConfigController`, `TaxConfigurationController` |

## 2. Not Yet Implemented

`finance` and `reporting` remain empty `package-info.java` placeholders in `bizco-server` — there
are no controllers or dedicated DTOs behind them yet. Their intended contracts are still
design-only, in [`ApiContracts.md`](../ApiContracts.md) sections 26–37 (Finance) and 41–42
(Reporting). Note that finance *data* partly exists already — `CashbookEntry`, `CustomerPayment`,
and `CustomerRefund` entities live under `com.bizco.server.finance.domain` and are written by the
Sales module's posting/payment/credit-note flows (see [Sales.md](Sales.md) §10, §12, §15) — what's
missing is a standalone Finance API surface (`/api/finance/receivables`, `/payables`, `/cashbook`)
and daily cash closing, not the underlying ledger data itself:

- Finance — no dedicated read API for cashbook/receivables/payables; no cash closing
  (expected/counted/variance/approval) at all
- Reporting — dashboard KPIs, all MVP reports, PDF/CSV export pipeline, backup/restore

Do not treat those sections of `ApiContracts.md` as implemented — they describe the target contract for future phases.

---

## 3. Shared Conventions (all implemented modules)

### 3.1 Base Paths

Every controller below is mounted under `/api/v1/...`. Several also keep a legacy/short alias (e.g. `/api/auth`, `/api/identity/users`, `/api/settings/tax`) registered on the same handler for backward compatibility — prefer the `/api/v1` path for new integrations.

### 3.2 Response Shape

Unlike the envelope (`{"data": {...}}`) described in `ApiContracts.md` §4, the current implementation returns response DTOs **directly** as the JSON body (no `data`/`meta` wrapper). Example:

```json
{
  "id": "7dd3929a-697c-46e1-a76f-989c76a67a24",
  "username": "cashier",
  "displayName": "Kasun Perera",
  "active": true,
  "version": 3
}
```

Paginated list endpoints return a flat search-response object with `data`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, `totalPages` fields at the top level (not nested under a separate `page` object):

```json
{
  "data": [ { } ],
  "page": 0,
  "size": 20,
  "totalElements": 115,
  "totalPages": 6
}
```

### 3.3 Authentication

```http
Authorization: Bearer <opaque-session-token>
```

Obtained from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Every endpoint other than `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and `GET /api/v1/health` requires a valid session; endpoints additionally enforce a specific permission via `@PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('...')")`, checked server-side regardless of what the JavaFX client shows.

### 3.4 Correlation ID

```http
X-Correlation-Id: <uuid>
```

Set by `CorrelationIdFilter` on every request/response; echoed back in `ApiError.correlationId` on failures. Clients may supply their own; the server generates one if absent.

### 3.5 Standard Error Shape

All errors thrown by the global `@RestControllerAdvice` (`ApiExceptionHandler`) use this shape:

```json
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "One or more fields are invalid.",
  "details": {},
  "fieldErrors": [
    {
      "field": "username",
      "code": "REQUIRED",
      "message": "Username is required."
    }
  ],
  "timestamp": "2026-08-16T10:15:00Z",
  "path": "/api/v1/auth/login",
  "correlationId": "9b1f2e3a-....-...."
}
```

| HTTP | When |
|---|---|
| 400 | `ApiValidationException` (field-level validation) or malformed JSON body |
| 401 | Session missing/invalid (`AuthenticationException`) |
| 403 | Authenticated but missing the required permission (`AccessDeniedException`) |
| 404 | No matching route (`NoResourceFoundException`) |
| 409 | Domain conflict — e.g. `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION`, duplicate code (raised as generic `IdentityException`/service exceptions today; not all modules map every conflict to 409 yet — check each module's status codes) |
| 500 | Any uncaught exception |

Domain error codes currently defined in `ApiErrorCode` (`bizco-common`), grouped by module:

- **General:** `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, `DOMAIN_RULE_REJECTED`, `SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `IDENTITY_ERROR`
- **Auth:** `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED`, `AUTH_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE`, `AUTH_CONCURRENT_SESSION_LIMIT`, `AUTH_SESSION_INVALID`, `AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED`, `AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED`
- **Customer:** `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`, `CUSTOMER_CODE_DUPLICATE`, `CUSTOMER_ANONYMIZATION_BLOCKED`, `CUSTOMER_CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `CUSTOMER_CREDIT_BLOCKED_BY_AGING`, `CUSTOMER_SALES_BLOCKED`
- **Catalog:** `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`, `PRODUCT_SKU_DUPLICATE`, `PRODUCT_BARCODE_DUPLICATE`, `PRODUCT_INACTIVE`, `CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND`, `CATEGORY_IN_USE`, `CATEGORY_CYCLE`, `UOM_NOT_FOUND`, `SERVICE_NOT_FOUND`, `SERVICE_CODE_DUPLICATE`
- **Purchasing:** `SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND`, `SUPPLIER_CODE_DUPLICATE`, `SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`, `SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_DUPLICATE`, `PURCHASE_ORDER_NOT_FOUND`, `PURCHASE_ORDER_NOT_DRAFT`, `PURCHASE_ORDER_INVALID_TRANSITION`, `PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEM_NOT_FOUND`, `GOODS_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND`, `GOODS_RECEIPT_NOT_DRAFT`, `GOODS_RECEIPT_ITEM_NOT_FOUND`, `GOODS_RECEIPT_SUPPLIER_REFERENCE_DUPLICATE`, `GOODS_RECEIPT_NOT_POSTED`, `SUPPLIER_RETURN_NOT_FOUND`, `SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND`
- **Sales:** `INVOICE_NOT_FOUND`, `INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT`, `INVOICE_NOT_POSTED`, `INVOICE_LINE_NOT_FOUND`, `INVOICE_DISCOUNT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `INVOICE_BELOW_COST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `INVOICE_CREDIT_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED`, `INVOICE_PAYMENT_REQUIRED`, `HELD_SALE_NOT_FOUND`, `HELD_SALE_NOT_ACTIVE`, `CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_FOUND`, `CREDIT_NOTE_ALREADY_SETTLED`, `RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED`, `RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED`
- **Scheduling:** `APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND`, `APPOINTMENT_CONFLICT`, `APPOINTMENT_INVALID_TRANSITION`, `APPOINTMENT_TECHNICIAN_INELIGIBLE`, `APPOINTMENT_ALREADY_CONVERTED`, `APPOINTMENT_NOT_CONVERTIBLE`, `JOB_CARD_NOT_FOUND`, `JOB_CARD_INVALID_TRANSITION`, `JOB_ESTIMATE_REQUIRED`, `JOB_ESTIMATE_NOT_FOUND`, `JOB_ESTIMATE_NOT_PENDING`, `JOB_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND`, `JOB_PART_PRODUCT_NOT_INVENTORY`
- **Inventory:** `STOCK_INSUFFICIENT`, `STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_NOT_FOUND`, `STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_ALREADY_DECIDED`, `STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_PRODUCT_NOT_INVENTORY`
- **Payments (shared sales/purchasing shape):** `PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH`, `PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE`

See `ApiErrorCode.java` itself for the authoritative, always-current list.

### 3.6 Optimistic Locking

Mutable resources carry a `long version` field. Update requests include the expected `version` in the request body; a stale value is rejected with `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION` (409) where the service checks it — see each module doc for which endpoints currently enforce this.

### 3.7 Money & Dates

- Money fields are `BigDecimal`, serialized as JSON numbers (e.g. `250000.00`).
- Timestamps are ISO-8601 instants (e.g. `"2026-08-16T10:15:00Z"`).
- UUID identifiers serialize as strings; reference/master data (categories, UOM, roles) use numeric (`Long`/`Short`) IDs.

---

## 4. Reading Order

Start with [Identity.md](Identity.md) for authentication, since every other endpoint depends on the bearer token it issues. A reasonable module order after that follows the dependency chain each module actually posts against: [Customer.md](Customer.md) and [Catalog.md](Catalog.md) (master data) → [Sales.md](Sales.md) (POS/invoicing, the heaviest module) → [Scheduling.md](Scheduling.md) (appointments/job cards, which itself generates a draft invoice — see its §10) → [Inventory.md](Inventory.md) and [Purchasing.md](Purchasing.md) (the stock ledger every sale/return/job-part/goods-receipt posts to) → [Audit.md](Audit.md) and [System.md](System.md).
